description: Low priority tech debt fixes: Fix requirements.txt Python version header (issue #11), add google-auth[aiohttp] for native async token refresh (issue #12), add cursor-based pagination to admin list endpoints (issue #13), and add API version header to OpenAPI spec (issue #14).
steps: Issue #11: In apps/backend/requirements.txt, change the header comment from 'Python 3.12' to 'Python 3.11' (line 3). In apps/backend/requirements.in, add a comment noting that requirements.txt should be compiled with --python-version 3.11.

Issue #12: In apps/backend/requirements.in, change 'google-auth' to 'google-auth[aiohttp]'. In apps/backend/app/services/ai/vertex_client.py, update _get_access_token() to try using google.auth.transport._aiohttp_requests.Request for native async refresh first, and fall back to the executor pattern if the aiohttp transport is not available.

Issue #13: In admin endpoints that return lists (apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_users.py, admin_conversations.py, admin_knowledge.py, admin_analytics.py), ensure they all have cursor-based or offset/limit pagination with a 'pagination' response field containing total, offset, limit, has_more. The admin_users.py and admin_conversations.py already have offset+limit. Check admin_knowledge.py list endpoint and admin_analytics.py - add pagination if missing. Add limit capping (max 100) to prevent abuse.

Issue #14: In apps/backend/app/main.py in create_app(), add an X-API-Version response header to the unified_middleware that returns the app version. Also add a version field to the OpenAPI schema info (it already has version='3.0.0' - just ensure it's meaningful). Add a simple /api/v1/changelog endpoint that returns a version list.
acceptance_criteria: requirements.txt header says Python 3.11 instead of 3.12
requirements.in includes google-auth[aiohttp] and a comment about --python-version 3.11
vertex_client.py _get_access_token() attempts native async refresh before falling back to executor
Admin list endpoints (users, conversations, knowledge) all have consistent pagination response
Unified middleware adds X-API-Version header to all responses
All 163 existing backend tests still pass
verification: Run python -m pytest from apps/backend/ and confirm all tests pass
